 NK leader meets Chinese FM 
 North Korean leader Kim Jong-un (3rd from L) shakes hands with Chinese Foreign Minister Yang Yi (4th from L) during their meeting at the New Amnok River Bridge on Oct. 24, 2026, in this photo released by the North's official Korean Central News Agency the next day.
